baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus construction attaches an open-ended wayl directly to the definite plural agent-class al-mutaffifin; the Form II participial shape presents fine diminution as their repeated, classifying act.
baseline_models.mechanism: On the focus wording alone, an apparently slight subtraction and an unsized consequence are set against each other: the agents make what is due marginally smaller, while the warning refuses to remain small. The focus root has no packet branch inventory, so the required branch-backed trace is retrospective support and not the source of this morphology-led baseline.

activation_trace.role: The food-measure image retrospectively confirms that the focus diminution concerns a metered due; it supports, but did not generate, the focus-only baseline.

changed_reading.before: A general curse against unspecified bad actors.
changed_reading.after: A deliberately disproportionate warning aimed at a stable class whose characteristic practice is repeated, fine-grained subtraction from what another is due.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus class is specified as operators of a directional protocol, not merely people who sometimes mismeasure: comparison and completion govern what enters toward them, while misalignment and induced loss govern what leaves toward others. The offense lies in making precision one-way.

activation_trace.role: Measurement as comparison between two matters supplies the relational interface that the mutaffif controls asymmetrically.
Completion without deficit defines the exacting intake side of the protocol.
Alignment between two things supplies the standard that outgoing measurement should preserve but the agent controls.
The explicit image of causing loss in measure and weight makes the outgoing deficit deliberate and functional.

structural_cues: The paired idha clauses reverse transaction direction: they receive against people, then measure or weigh for them.
Full completion is maximized on intake, whereas caused loss closes the output clause.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies comparison, full intake, alignment, and outgoing loss; I infer that their ordered contrast is a reusable one-way extraction protocol. A narrower live alternative is ordinary cheating in two named market operations without a broader protocol model.

changed_reading.before: People who shave a little from a quantity.
changed_reading.after: People who impose exactness when value flows toward them and manufacture tolerance for deficit when value flows away from them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The agent-class named in the focus loses control of the standard. Those who manipulated comparison are stirred from rest and made to stand in a universal scene whose q-w-m inventory includes resurrection, valuation, and equal measure. The commercial measurer becomes the evaluated person.

activation_trace.role: Certainty reached from an indicator turns the warning from remote possibility into a conclusion the visible practice should already imply.
Stirring what is still supplies the forced transition from protected routine to exposure.
Resurrection and standing establish the literal universal summons.
Valuation and pricing activate the reversal in which the former setter of quantities is now valued.
Equal weight and balanced magnitude sharpen the counter-standard applied to the asymmetric measurer.

structural_cues: The rhetorical question moves directly from their conduct to being raised.
The sequence expands from particular transactions with people to all people standing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies resurrection plus q-w-m images of valuation and equal measure; I supply the role-reversal arrow from manipulating standards to being subjected to one. The materially live alternative is that q-w-m contributes bodily standing only.

changed_reading.before: The warning predicts punishment after commercial fraud.
changed_reading.after: The warning announces a reversal of evaluative control: those who made the scale serve them will themselves stand under a standard they cannot tune.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus act is small per event but habitual in its agent noun. Joining entries, entering a name in a register, fixing a visible mark, confinement, and later witnessing form an accumulation mechanism: dispersed marginal deficits are gathered into an inspectable record that in turn binds the actor.

activation_trace.role: Joining one thing to another supplies aggregation of individually slight acts.
Entry of a name into a register turns repeated conduct into actor-linked classification.
A marked line in a book supplies durable, itemized traceability.
Confinement makes the accumulated record function as a binding consequence rather than passive documentation.
Presence with direct witnessing makes the record inspectable and blocks the shelter of unnoticed smallness.

structural_cues: The compact definition kitab marqum recurs for both contrasted records.
The focus uses a plural habitual agent label, allowing many slight events to be gathered under one class.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies joining, registration, marking, confinement, and witnessing; I infer that the tiny focus losses are the repeated units being accumulated. A live alternative is that the records classify whole careers without itemizing transactions.

changed_reading.before: Each short measure is too slight to leave a consequential trace.
changed_reading.after: Slightness is the concealment strategy, not an escape from accounting: repeated micro-deficits join into a marked and witnessed record that binds its maker.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact wayl-to-agent refrain reappears for deniers, then earned gains are said to produce an inescapable coating and blocked access. This activates a feedback loop anchored in the focus practice: profitable diminishment does not remain an external act; repetition deposits a perceptual barrier that helps the actor deny the account that would expose it.

activation_trace.role: Contradiction of truth supplies the second agent-class linked by the repeated warning formula.
A condition with no exit gives accumulated practice the function of a self-reinforcing perceptual enclosure.
Seeking and obtaining gain supplies the input repeatedly deposited into that enclosure.
Prevention of access externalizes the barrier produced by the gain-and-coating loop.

structural_cues: 83:1 and 83:10 share the wayl plus lam plus definite plural agent construction.
The explicit ma kanu yaksibun clause gives earned practice a causal relation to the coating.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denial, earned gain, coating, and blocked access; I infer from the warning refrain and sequence that focus-style gain participates in the coating. The alternative is that the causal earnings denote a much wider field of wrongdoing.

changed_reading.before: Under-measuring is an external economic offense committed by an otherwise clear-sighted calculator.
changed_reading.after: The extracted margin feeds a self-sealing cognition: repeated gain from diminishment trains the actor not to recognize the standard that judges it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The drink sequence forms a material counter-image to the focus transfer: an allotted flow is sealed against interference, its mixture is named, its source is named, and competition is redirected toward the valuable good itself. The mutaffif instead competes by degrading the other party's allocation. This preserves a quantity reading while opening an exploratory integrity-and-provenance reading.

activation_trace.role: An allotted share and its channel supply the due transfer that must arrive intact.
A secure preventing seal supplies custody against subtraction or tampering.
A valuable thing for which selves compete relocates rivalry from harming a counterparty to pursuing genuine value.
Explicit mixture supplies disclosed composition rather than concealed degradation.
A flowing source supplies traceable provenance for the transferred good.

structural_cues: The sequence proceeds from served good to seal, named mixture, named source, and drinking.
The imperative to compete interrupts the material description and assigns a different object to rivalry.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies allotment, secure seal, valued competition, mixture, and source; I map them onto transfer integrity and contrast that chain with focus diminution. The live alternative is a reward description with no commercial or custody analogy.

changed_reading.before: The focus condemns only a numerical shortfall at the point of sale.
changed_reading.after: It can also diagnose corrupted transfer integrity: advantage gained by reducing an allotment, interfering with custody, or hiding composition, contrasted with a sealed and source-declared good.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later group repeatedly encounters believers, circulates amusement among its own people, and pronounces the others astray, although it has no commission to guard them. This activates a coexisting social mechanism in the focus agent-name: tatfif can be carried as a metaphor for shaving another person's standing through gaze, joke, and unauthorized verdict while preserving full standing for one's own group.

activation_trace.role: Joy or surprise made visible by laughter turns devaluation into a public group signal.
Amusement at people's honor supplies the in-group circulation of another group's reduced status.
Passing judgment upon another gives the spoken label a status-setting function.
Deviation from guidance supplies the adverse valuation imposed by that verdict.
Sending and commissioning supplies the authority explicitly negated for the mockers.
Guarding and oversight define the role they implicitly assume but were not assigned.

structural_cues: Three encounter scenes use repeated idha movement: laughing at them, signaling while passing, then returning to one's own people amused.
The missing g-m-z inventory at 83:30 is used only as the structural cue of reciprocal signaling; no branch ID is supplied for it.
The negation in 83:33 blocks any claim that the group was appointed over the people it evaluates.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies public mockery, honor-directed amusement, an adverse verdict, and absence of evaluative commission; I infer a social analogue of short measure anchored in the focus idea of making another's due smaller. The alternative is a strict topical shift from traders to a separate mocking group.

changed_reading.before: Tatfif concerns quantities while social ridicule is a separate later offense.
changed_reading.after: A coexisting reading treats ridicule as human shortweighting: an in-group grants itself full standing and trims dignity from others through repeated, unauthorized assessment.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final reversal swaps laugher and observed, then describes recompense as an action returning to its actor. This sharpens the focus lam: wayl is not an unrelated excess attached to a tiny offense but the destination of a return loop. The one-way deficit is answered by a consequence that comes fully back to its maker.

activation_trace.role: The same visible laughter with reversed subjects supplies experiential role reversal.
Matching like with like until they are equal supplies the balancing logic of the reversal.
Recompense returning to the worker supplies the directional arrow back to the focus agent.
The enacted deed identifies what generates the returning consequence.

structural_cues: Laughter at believers in 83:29 is reversed into believers laughing in 83:34.
The closing question ties recompense directly to what they had been doing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reversed roles, equalizing observation, returned recompense, and enacted work; I infer that the lam in the focus marks the endpoint of that return. The alternative is a general final recompense without a specific accounting symmetry.

changed_reading.before: Wayl is a large but externally imposed penalty for a small theft.
changed_reading.after: Wayl is the completed return path of the asymmetry itself: the deficit the actor exported no longer stays with the victim but comes back as the actor's due.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the transaction-increase image comes from the non-dominant r-b-w mapping at the source word Rabb and must not be presented as the lexical meaning of Rabb. It remains worth carrying because the packet deliberately exposes split mappings and the image forms an exact mechanical mirror with the focus: demanded increase or fullness inward, induced deficit outward. Render only as a branch-triggered transactional echo, never as a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus agent is defined by making another's due minutely smaller; the outlier tests the complementary inward demand for increase that sustains that act.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant transaction-increase image activates the inward enlargement paired with outward diminution.
Full receipt without deficit supplies the ordinary inward maximization side of the mirror.
Caused loss in measure supplies the outward subtraction side of the mirror.

changed_reading.before: Tatfif is a standalone act of giving slightly less.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, tatfif is one half of a two-sided deformation: expand the claim flowing toward oneself and contract the due flowing toward another.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because smallness comes from the non-dominant q-l-l mapping of q-w-l at qalu; it cannot lexicalize the verb as anything other than saying. It remains anchored because the speech immediately assigns a diminished social verdict and the focus names agents of making little. Downstream prose should call it a sound-map activation of verbal belittling, not a translation claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Al-mutaffifin supplies the agentive action of making a due smaller; the outlier asks whether a spoken status verdict can perform the same action on human standing.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant smallness image activates speech as an instrument that makes its target socially little.
The dominant image of imposing judgment on another supplies the actual speech act through which diminution operates.
Amusement with people's honor supplies the social domain in which the verbal subtraction has value for the in-group.

changed_reading.before: The focus class manipulates only scales and measures.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its pattern also appears when authoritative-sounding speech shaves value from people and converts their reduced standing into group entertainment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because enumeration and return arise from non-dominant split mappings of the source root at mu'tadin, so neither image should be substituted for the word's ordinary transgression sense. It remains structurally useful because counted recurrence explains how a tiny focus subtraction becomes systematic and recordable. Render as an abductive process model, not as hidden etymology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The Form II plural agent in the focus supports repeated production of small deficits rather than one accidental shortage.

activation_trace.role: Enumeration supplies discrete counting of each small extraction as an operation.
Return after a beginning supplies iteration of the same operation across encounters.
Joining units supplies accumulation of the repeated counted cuts into a consequential total.

changed_reading.before: A mutaffif opportunistically removes an almost negligible amount.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, tatfif behaves like an algorithm: count a tiny cut, repeat it, and join the outputs until negligible units become a governing total.

strongest_changes: The focus moved from isolated petty cheating to a directional system that demands full precision inward and exports deficit outward.
The measurer-to-measured reversal and the marked record make hidden smallness a temporary concealment strategy rather than an escape from evaluation.
Earned margin can become a self-sealing perceptual habit, linking economic extraction with denial of the standard that exposes it.
Commercial shortweighting coexists with social shortweighting, where gaze, ridicule, and unauthorized verdict reduce another person's standing.
The closing return mechanism reframes wayl as the completed path by which exported asymmetry comes back to its maker.
summary.what_was_special: The missing focus inventory forced a transparent morphology-led baseline, while split mappings and later material and social sequences activated unusually coherent mirrors: inward increase versus outward deficit, sealed provenance versus corrupted transfer, speech as belittling, and counted repetition as an accumulation algorithm. These remain coexisting readings rather than a single resolved interpretation.
remaining_uncertainties: Because t-f-f has no packet branch inventory, the baseline branch citation is retrospective support rather than focus-branch evidence.
The transfer-integrity and social-status extensions are mechanically anchored but remain broader than literal quantity fraud.
The r-b-w, q-l-l, enumeration, and recurrence activations depend on non-dominant split mappings and require explicit containment in any downstream rendering.
The record may aggregate particular micro-transactions or may classify a wider life-pattern; the packet supports both scales.
